record.question: Which of the following statements about Contractor's Ledger is incorrect?
options: Only one account is kept in respect of one contractor irrespective of the number of contracts undertaken by him.
All the financial transactions of contractor are entered in the ledger.
The contractor's ledger should invariably be maintained in the Sub-Divisional Office.
A personal account must be opened in the ledger for a contractor unless the work or supply entrusted to him is un-important and no payment is made except on a First and Final Bill.
record.explanation: The contractor's ledger is not invariably maintained in the sub-divisional office.
